impact:
Rerun 14 confirmed H1 (keyframes_seen stays at 1); rerun 15 diagnostics decided H1a vs H1b in favour of H1a (NVENC effectively infinite GOP).

PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION (2026-05-20, pre-smoke):
- helper/src/encoder/backends/nvenc/mod.rs: added NV_ENC_PIC_FLAG_FORCEIDR (0x2), gop_size+frame_count fields on EncodeSession, FORCEIDR OR'd into encodePicFlags every gop_size frames (frame_count % gop_size == 0). Removed first-frame-only is_keyframe heuristic.
- Drain derives emitted EncodedFragment.is_keyframe from nal_counts.idr > 0; fmp4::build_fragment receives the same bitstream-derived bool. Encoder-side intent no longer rides on PendingFrame.
- New hardware-gated test nvenc_periodic_idr_at_gop_boundary asserts >=2 keyframes near frame 0 and gop_size (gop_size=15, push 16 frames). Test passes on real NVENC → H1a fix confirmed at unit-test level.

PHASE 2 DIAGNOSTICS (additive, never gates behaviour):
- helper/src/encoder/fragment.rs: NV_ENC_PIC_TYPE_IDR=3 constant.
- helper/src/segment/buffer.rs: cumulative idr_nal_count_total / picture_type_idr_count_total in BufferInner, incremented in push, emitted in SegmentDiagnosticsEvent.
- helper/src/protocol/events.rs + sim/dispatch.rs: additive u64 fields.
- New integration test cumulative_idr_counters_track_diagnostics_without_committing proves counters increment and the commit predicate stays gated on is_keyframe.

NOT RESOLVED — resolution requires smoke rerun 16 proving VAL-SEG-003 green (segments_committed > 0, replay.save success). Commit predicate, replay.save, validation, capture, and VAL-CAP-004 are unchanged.
resolution: VAL-SEG-003 green in reruns 16–27. NVENC FORCEIDR, bitstream-derived is_keyframe, and cumulative IDR diagnostics/integration coverage validated.
